zhask.name: Zhask
zhask.description: Zhask, the one who manipulates all, is a nightmare to this universe. The staff in his hand is the proof of his ultimate power.

zilong.name: Zilong
zilong.description: In every era, there's a day when people witness the arrival of the dragonborn. Sometimes Zilong reincarnates as a heroic warrior, sometimes he is reborn as a world- world-changing scholar. But in the Land of Dawn nowadays, Zilong is the fighter who exterminates evil beings.
